text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass walls and modern aesthetics of the first scene evoke a sensation of transparency and potential, as if I am standing on the threshold of new ideas and possibilities. Moving into the R+D space, there is a tangible pulse of innovation—words on the wall promise creativity and advancement. Surrounded by screens and artifacts, I feel both awe and humility, reminded of the continuous evolution of knowledge and my small, yet significant, place within this vast pursuit for understanding.
